system.description:
Rogues are the back-alley urchins, gutterborn scum, and shadowed assassins. To hammers, every problem looks like a nail. Rogues are

blades, and every problem is a throat.


Iconic Rogues

• Locke Lamora, Gentleman Bastard Sequence

• Nona Grey, Book of the Ancestor

• Vin, Mistborn

• Zidane Tribal, Final Fantasy IX


Playing Rogue

Rogues are low-defense, midline harassers that focus on one single, deadly shot. They are given Features that reinforce attempting to gain Favor on their Attacks.


Action: Attack

Move: Midline


Training: Ranged, Finesse, Sneak

features.name: Sneak Attack
features.description:
The first time you hit with a Favored attack on a Turn with a Finesse, Keen, or Ranged Weapon, it deals an extra d4 damage and ignores an amount of Armor equal to this number of extra dice.


The number of extra d4s increases by 1 every 3 Levels hereafter.

features.name: Infiltrator
features.description: You gain the Resourceful Perk, and you have Favor on Checks and Saves made to ambush and against traps that you are aware of.

features.name: Knack
features.description:
You gain 1 Luck during a Breather and when you Crit, in addition to other Crit benefits.


Further, when you Rest, you gain 1 extra Luck.


This extra Luck gained from a Rest increases by 1 every 4 Levels hereafter.

features.name: Evasive
features.description:
Once per Round after another Being uses an Action or Move, you can Move 10’ without using Speed and can continue moving using your remaining Speed.


This free Speed increases by 5’ every 4 levels hereafter.

features.name: Lethal Weapon
features.description: Your Sneak Attack damage dice can Explode.

features.name: Waylay
features.description: When you kill an Enemy or use your Evasive Ability, you can spend 1 Luck to immediately take an Action. You can’t spend more than 1 Luck on this Ability at a time.
